topic: Three free things to do before you spend a dollar on marketing
caption:
Spend zero dollars first.

Claim your Google Business Profile. Ask three customers for a review. Then Google yourself and see what a stranger sees.

Fix those three things before you buy a single ad.

When you're ready for a site that makes all of it work harder, we're here. Link in bio.
